recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-20168 unless a future final decision changes CarePlan.addresses target profiles or CodeableReference modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-20168 was Published/Persuasive and requested CarePlan.addressesCode 0..* CodeableConcept plus CarePlan.addressesReference 0..* Reference(Condition), with usage guidance for coded concerns versus referenced concerns.
initial_application: The Jira comment identified GH#218ec67. Commit 218ec67c42b8156bcd8330a57848603b297321d3 applied GF#20168 by adding the split addressesCode/addressesReference elements and updating examples. Commit 7daa0d220d80bdaf2229f7aa05f4d4e6c0f5a698 later converted repeating code/reference patterns to CodeableReference, including CarePlan.addresses, and commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 moved the source into the current StructureDefinition XML shape.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists careplan=CarePlan. The current source/careplan/structuredefinition-CarePlan.xml defines CarePlan.addresses as 0..* CodeableReference with a clinical-findings binding and reference target profiles including Condition, while preserving the concept/reference usage comment. FHIR-32512 later expanded the reference targets to include Procedure and MedicationAdministration and already has a reconciliation commit on the combined branch. FHIR-54076 is a later Triaged unresolved proposal to add ImmunizationRecommendation and was not in scope for a source edit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current CodeableReference form is the correct modern expression of the FHIR-20168 request, and reverting to separate addressesCode/addressesReference elements would conflict with the later R5 modeling refactor.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied decision expanded CarePlan.addresses reference targets beyond Condition; already represented on the combined branch and used only as supporting context here.
